cases.name: non_git_dir
cases.scenario: Call export_evidence on a plain directory with no .git

cases.name: no_commit_repo
cases.scenario: git init a directory but make no commits, then call export_evidence
cases.outcome: ValueError: Git repository at '/private/var/folders/dy/k9c_fpxn5h5cbb9hdsj3zzkm0000gn/T/tmpnkzgz3zw' has no commits — a real head_sha cannot be captured.

cases.name: runtime_missing_head_sha
cases.scenario: Validate project_evidence_export instance with generated_from_fixture=false and repo_state.head_sha=null
cases.expectation: Schema rejects: allOf runtime head_sha gate fires (null is not valid string)
cases.outcome: 1 validation error(s): None is not of type 'string'

cases.name: old_dopemux_field
cases.scenario: Validate project_evidence_export instance whose forbidden_action_confirmation uses old key dopetask_executed
cases.expectation: Schema rejects due to additionalProperties:false on forbidden_action_confirmation
cases.outcome: Rejected (additionalProperties): Additional properties are not allowed ('dopetask_executed', 'live_task_orchestrator_written' were unexpected)

cases.name: secret_content_no_leak
cases.scenario: Commit a file containing a unique marker to a tmp repo; run export_evidence; check the JSON
cases.expectation: Secret marker absent from export JSON (exporter records paths, not content)
cases.outcome: Marker 'TRAP_SECRET_A7B3C9D2E5F1' absent from export JSON (1675 chars); exporter records paths only
